title: CLCON/63/2008 of PARAMJEET SINGH Vs VINOD FONIA and ANR

paras.text:
Contempt Petition No.63 of 2008
Mr. Rakesh Thapaliyal, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. S. Dhulia, Advocate for the respondents-contemnors.
The show-cause has been filed by both the contemnors. Unconditional apologies
have been placed on record. We accept the apologies and drop the proceedings,
especially in view of the fact that the Court's direction has now been complied with and
vide order issued on 01st July 2008 the petitioner Mr. Paramjeet Singh has been
promoted as Superintendent Engineer provisionally subject to result of the pending
litigation.
The Contempt Petition is disposed of.

(J.C.S. Rawat, J.) (V. K. Gupta, C.J.)
Dated 07.07.2008
LSR / Shiv
